=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1443,1680,1839 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new off switch UNBLOCK_SKIP_E2E_TEST_ITEMS_ENABLED is read from the process environment by scripts/unblock_scan.py, but the workflow does not map it from vars.*, so a repository variable has no effect.
  WHY: Only the env: block carries repository variables into the poller step, so operators cannot turn the skip off from repository settings. Severity is NIT for both reviewers; confidence is 2 and 3. The reviewers note the workflow is outside the plan grant's files_touched.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25648-25660,25671-25682 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The GraphQL details query and the jq projection to details.json never carry `title`, so the details-title fallback in `_item_title` (scripts/unblock_scan.py:178-187) is unreachable in production.
  WHY: The skip still works through the search projection (line 25605), but the documented and tested fallback is dead code in the shipped wiring. Severity is NIT for glm-5_3-flash; minimax-m3 raised the same root cause as a MAJOR task gap (see task gaps).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "If the search payload does not carry the title, read it from details[number]['title'] when present; a missing title means do not skip."
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh (run_unblock_scan GraphQL details fragment and jq projection around lines 25644-25682)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25644-25660 GraphQL details query selects no title, the jq projection at 25671-25682 never extracts title, so the details-fallback in scripts/unblock_scan.py:_item_title (187-196) is unreachable in production. minimax-m3 rated this MAJOR.
- requirement: "Put the skip behind the env var UNBLOCK_SKIP_E2E_TEST_ITEMS_ENABLED, default true; only the value 'false' turns it off."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml env: blocks for the poller step (near UNBLOCK_JUDGE_* at lines 1443/1453-1456, 1680/1690-1693, 1839/1847-1850); README.md variables table
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: orchestrate_poll.yml does not map UNBLOCK_SKIP_E2E_TEST_ITEMS_ENABLED from vars, and README.md has no row for it, so the repository-variable opt-out does not reach the Python process. Both reviewers rated this NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1443,1680,1839 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The new off switch is read from the process environment by scripts/unblock_scan.py, but the workflow does not map it from vars.*, so setting a repository variable has no effect.
  WHY: Only the env: block carries repository variables into the poller step. The default is still correct, and the mapping would go beyond the granted scope, so this is advisory only (source severity NIT).
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_scan.py `E2E_TEST_TITLE_RE.search` in select() — the regex is unanchored as the issue specifies, so no change is needed. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

TASK_GAP:

  evidence of absence: scripts/unblock_scan.py:_item_title reads info.get("title") (lines 187-196), but the GraphQL details query in scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25644-25660 never selects title and the jq projection at lines 25671-25682 never extracts it, so the details-fallback branch is unreachable in production wiring.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
TASK_GAP:

  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml env: blocks (around lines 1453-1456, 1690-1693, 1847-1850) and the README.md variables table (around lines 112-119)
  evidence of absence: the workflow does not pass UNBLOCK_SKIP_E2E_TEST_ITEMS_ENABLED through vars and README.md has no row for it, so the off switch is not reachable from the variables surface.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
TASK_GAP:
- requirement: "Put the skip behind the env var UNBLOCK_SKIP_E2E_TEST_ITEMS_ENABLED" so setting it to false turns the skip off.
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml (both poller invocations' environment mappings); README.md variable reference
  evidence of absence: The active-poll and idle-scan environment mappings do not expose the variable and README.md has no entry, so a repository Actions variable leaves the Python process's variable unset and the default-on skip stays enabled.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:25648-25660,25671-25682 | severity=low | confidence=4

  WHY: The skip still works through the search projection (line 25605), but the documented and tested fallback is dead code in the shipped wiring (source severity NIT).
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1443,1680,1839 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: No Actions surface maps UNBLOCK_SKIP_E2E_TEST_ITEMS_ENABLED into the poller step's environment, and the README variables table has no row for it.
  WHY: Setting the repository variable has no effect, so the changelog's "turn it off" path is not reachable from repository settings. The files are outside the issue's files_touched grant (source severity NIT).
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh GraphQL fragments (25648-25660) and details jq projection (25671-25682) — add `title` to both `... on Issue` and `... on PullRequest` fragments and `title: (.value.title // null)` to the projection (~3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
